verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a security check that pairs static scanning with an AI security agent on every pull request [greptile-docs-25]. This runs alongside its standard bug-finding PR review [greptile-docs-1, greptile-docs-26], and custom rules can encode team-specific insecure patterns [greptile-docs-21]. Community feedback that it 'catches real issues' is generic, not security-specific [greptile-comm-8]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the categories detected (injection risks, leaked secrets, specific insecure patterns); independent or hands-on corroboration of security findings in review comments.
